improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and an unlimited workspace. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-gideon-preview.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon does, who it serves, and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the price anchor (US$2/day) sets expectations and attracts qualified leads.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately names the product and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the low-friction free trial. 'No card required' removes a common conversion barrier and builds trust. The copy stays factual, avoids hype, and speaks directly to the target audience of business owners and traders.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, and annual plans save you 30 percent. Your free searches give you a real taste of what Gideon can do—no credit card required to start.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium-to-paid model: what happens at the paywall. By setting clear expectations upfront, it reduces anxiety, builds trust, and smoothly introduces pricing without pressure. Mentioning 'no credit card required' removes a key barrier to trial engagement.
